policy: Client modules may reach server-owned modules, and lmcache modules the client wheel does not ship, only through the entries below. Keys are (file, scope, target, phase, kind, names); phase is type-only or runtime, so a changed guard, scope or kind is a new, unlisted edge. sites (default 1) is the number of edges an entry covers. Non-literal dynamic imports are listed per call site with the module space they can reach. Checked by check_split_boundary.py.

optional native acceleration: lmcache.cuda_ops is a server-owned GPU extension, built only by the GPU build profiles of lmcache-server. Triggered by the first device op that calls CudaDeviceOps.ensure_native; when lmcache-server or the extension is absent the ImportError is caught, a warning is logged and the torch baseline runs multi_layer_block_kv_transfer (transfer_context/base.py). GPU correctness and speed of that fallback are an open GPU check; a separate kernels distribution is the alternative.

optional native acceleration: lmcache.xpu_ops is a server-owned GPU extension, built only by the GPU build profiles of lmcache-server. Triggered by the first device op that calls XpuDeviceOps.ensure_native; when lmcache-server or the extension is absent the ImportError is caught, a warning is logged and the torch baseline runs every op. GPU correctness and speed of that fallback are an open GPU check; a separate kernels distribution is the alternative.

optional native acceleration: lmcache.xpu_ops is a server-owned GPU extension, built only by the GPU build profiles of lmcache-server. Triggered by the first device op that calls _load_xpu_ops; when lmcache-server or the extension is absent the ImportError is caught, a warning is logged and pin_memory falls back to unregistered host memory. GPU correctness and speed of that fallback are an open GPU check; a separate kernels distribution is the alternative.
